historical_commentary.text: 4D Chart was the bundled charting solution for 4D applications throughout the classic-language era, but 4D later introduced SVG-based charting components and, more broadly, moved toward web-technology-based visualization (HTML/CSS/JS charting libraries rendered in Web areas) as richer, more modern alternatives, making the specific 4D Chart plug-in and its command set increasingly superseded for new development. Developers building dashboards or reports in current 4D applications are more likely to reach for SVG/JS charting approaches than the original 4D Chart plug-in.
related_updates: 4D introduced SVG-based charting technical notes/components as a more modern alternative to the original 4D Chart plug-in
Modern 4D charting needs are commonly met via Web areas embedding JavaScript charting libraries rather than the native 4D Chart plug-in
